interface.name: org_kde_kwin_blur_manager
interface.description: This interface allows a client to request blur behind a surface.

request.name: create
request.description: Create a blur object for the given surface.

interface.name: org_kde_kwin_blur
interface.description: This interface allows a client to set blur region.

request.name: commit
request.description: Apply the blur region to the surface.

request.name: set_region
request.description: Set the region of the surface to be blurred. If no region is set, the entire surface will be blurred.
